name: web-project
description: Food ordering platform: Express API + customer site (CRA) + admin dashboard (Vite). Root scripts fan out to the three packages.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Back-end install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix Front-end/User install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix Front-end/Admin install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: npm --prefix Back-end test && cross-env-shell CI=true npm --prefix Front-end/User test -- --watchAll=false
scripts.build: cross-env-shell CI=false npm --prefix Front-end/User run build && npm --prefix Front-end/Admin run build
